title: Geometry Dash Death
blurb: Heard, on average, several hundred times per level, and considerably more if the level was built by somebody with a grudge. RobTop's rhythm platformer syncs everything to the music, so dying does more than register failure: it cuts the track out at the exact moment you were enjoying it. The sound is brief and blunt. Then another attempt, because the restart is instant and that hook is the whole game. Play it for repeated failures, particularly ones you are visibly about to repeat again within four seconds.
origin: The death sound from Geometry Dash.
